newsitem.title: USA: Futures Magazine sold to New York-based group.
newsitem.headline: Futures Magazine sold to New York-based group.

text.p: Futures Communications Co said Monday it bought Futures Magazine and the Futures Magazine Division from Oster Communications Inc.
Terms of the deal were not disclosed.
Futures Communications is a new New York-based company formed by Berwick Capital Inc and Media/Communications Partners, a Boston-based private investment firm.
Robert Andrialis, a principal of Berwick, is chairman and chief executive officer of Futures Communications and new publisher of Futures Magazine.
The magazine, which focuses on futures, options and derivatives markets, will remain based in Chicago.
Futures Magazine Division president Joe Bernardo becomes president of the renamed Futures Magazine Group, Futures Communications said.
